name: Madeleine Rey
want: build the movement in Lyon into something that can fight
secret: She was a Communist Party member until 1939, and she still meets a contact from the communist armed groups whom the movement's leaders have forbidden her to work with.
voice: Brisk and amused; quotes poets when she's nervous.
description: Her bookshop on the montée is the group's letter box. She recruits, organises and decides, and nobody remembers agreeing that she should.
appearance: Tall, grey-streaked hair in a bun, reading glasses on a chain, a cardigan with pockets full of slips of paper.
